notes: Boa Safra Sementes (SOJA3) — Brazil's #1 independent soybean seed producer (Formosa-GO HQ). IPO on B3 Novo Mercado April 2021 (R$400M primary at R$9.90/share). BRL reporting, calendar fiscal year. Pure-play soybean seed multiplier — buys foundation seed from licensors (Bayer/BASF/Corteva/GDM), multiplies through contracted growers, conditions, treats, packages and sells to ~10k+ farmers. Revenue is highly seasonal, concentrated in 3T/4T (Sep-Dec planting season for Brazilian soja safra). grossRevenueMM = receita bruta (pre-PIS/COFINS/ICMS), revenueMM = receita líquida. Expenses split as CPV (custo dos produtos vendidos), G&A (despesas gerais e administrativas), D&A (depreciação e amortização), Outras (other opex). 5-year FY history from CVM ITR/DFP filings + ri.boasafra.com.br release decks. Pre-IPO 2020 figures from S-1 (Prospecto Definitivo) and post-IPO restatements. Net debt rose materially 2022-2024 as company built working capital + new processing units (Cristalina-GO, Rio Verde-GO). Receita líquida 2024 hit by harvest delays + farmer credit stress, FY24 EBITDA margin compressed.

periods.notes: FY20 (pré-IPO): receita líquida R$442M, EBITDA R$60M (~13.6% margin). Last private year before April 2021 Novo Mercado listing. Net debt R$140M, equity ~R$145M. Source: Prospecto Definitivo IPO + 2020 DFP refilled.
FY21 (ano da IPO): receita líquida R$663M (+50% YoY), EBITDA R$110M (16.6% margin). IPO R$400M primary recebido 04/2021 — caixa líquido positivo no fim do ano. Net cash R$90M. Source: 2021 DFP.
FY22: receita líquida R$1.02B (+53% YoY) com expansão de capacidade (UBS Cristalina), EBITDA R$175M (17.2%). Capex acelerado consume IPO cash; net debt sobe para R$290M. Source: 2022 DFP.

FY23: receita líquida R$1.34B (+32% YoY), EBITDA R$215M (16.1% margem). Volume de sementes ~6M sacas. Net debt R$520M (1.4x EBITDA) — capex em planta de Rio Verde + working capital de safra. Source: 2023 DFP.

FY24: receita líquida R$1.70B (+27% YoY), mas EBITDA cai para R$200M (11.8% margem) sob estresse de crédito agrícola, atrasos de safra e maior PDD (provisão devedores duvidosos). Net debt R$750M (3.75x EBITDA) — leverage spike. Dividendo reduzido. Source: 2024 DFP.
